build_dm_robotics_moma_package: build the dm_robotics-moma package using setuptools setup with all model and vendor packages included
get_requirements_from_file: get a list of python dependencies from a requirements.txt file ignoring -r include lines
parse_requirements_line: parse a single requirements.txt line and strip comments and whitespace to get the package spec
get_recursive_packages: get all recursive python packages under a directory with optional skip paths and a dm_robotics prefix
get_recursive_subfolders: get all recursive subfolder paths under a directory with optional skip paths for package data inclusion
